mona_aboutus_descriptions.title: About Us
mona_aboutus_descriptions.description: Adtek was founded in 2021 to help brands grow their businesses from branding building to revenue growth. Unlike other agencies, we combine creatives and data-driven to provide end-to-end marketing strategies from branding, user acquisition, and user retention. We challenge conventional marketing methods by understanding clients’ markets, profoundly diving into their problems, and growing clients’ businesses at scale.
